purpose: Canonical contract documenting the raw dataset schema, canonical flow features, target labels, and live-telemetry mapping architecture.

raw_label.description: Verbatim original label from the raw dataset, preserving all specific variants.

attack_family.description: Normalized canonical attack family: BENIGN, DOS, DDOS, PORT_SCAN, BRUTE_FORCE, BOTNET, WEB_ATTACK, INFILTRATION, HEARTBLEED.

is_attack.description: Binary classification label: 0 for BENIGN/NORMAL, 1 for malicious attack.

canonical_baseline_features.name: total_forward_packets
canonical_baseline_features.description: Total packets sent in forward direction.

canonical_baseline_features.name: total_backward_packets
canonical_baseline_features.description: Total packets sent in backward direction.

canonical_baseline_features.name: total_forward_bytes
canonical_baseline_features.description: Total bytes sent in forward direction.

canonical_baseline_features.name: total_backward_bytes
canonical_baseline_features.description: Total bytes sent in backward direction.

schema_layers_distinction.raw_dataset_schema: 78 numeric flow features generated by CICFlowMeter + 1 raw Label column. Protocol is NOT present in raw CICIDS2017 CSVs. Full inventory documented in docs/data-dictionary.md.
schema_layers_distinction.canonical_model_feature_schema: Standardized, leakage-safe subset of features for baseline training, anomaly detection (Isolation Forest), and multi-class classification (XGBoost/Random Forest).
schema_layers_distinction.telemetry_adapter_schema: Future live telemetry adapter mapping Zeek conn.log / flow records to canonical features, supplying contextual metadata (e.g. protocol, service) to the decision engine.

notes: IP addresses are deliberately excluded from model features to prevent memorization/leakage.
DOS and DDOS are strictly treated as separate attack families.
All raw labels (e.g. individual DoS tools, Web Attack types, Patator tools, Heartbleed, Infiltration) are preserved verbatim in raw_label.
Feature selection among all 78 candidate features will occur in Stage 3 after correlation and leakage analysis.
